component.name: Obour
عبور
component.summary: Run apps from remote Linux machines as local windows
شغّل تطبيقات حواسيب لينكس البعيدة كنوافذ محلية

description.p: Obour (عبور, “crossing”) opens individual apps from other Linux computers over SSH so they appear as normal windows on your desktop, with sound. Wayland apps are forwarded with waypipe and X11 apps with SSH X11 forwarding.

ul.li: Browse a computer's installed apps and add them in one click
Sound through your local PipeWire or PulseAudio
Matches your light or dark style and your cursor theme
Checks each host for missing tools and offers to install them
Tailscale addresses, key login setup and app-menu entries
